lessons: The review found a test gap in tests/unit/test_requisition_panel.py `test_failures` (criterion 6). The implementation was sound. Redo the full ticket from the merge base and fix the member-failing test as described below.

In the criterion-6 member-failing case (m0 raises ProviderCallError, m1 replies snag), assert the panel_facts event has `member_count == 2` and `merged[0]["members"] == [0]`, in addition to `dropped` and `members[0].provider`.
In that same case, check that the returned verdict's `verdict`, `summary` and `findings` equal member 1's reply (`snag`, its summary, `[finding()]`). Checking only verdict == 'snag' is not enough.

Before committing, go through criteria 1-7 one by one. Check that every value each criterion names is asserted exactly. Review rejects any named value that has no assertion. Then run the mutation check that Scope in requires for criteria 1 and 4.
